targets.title: To push or not to push? Affective influences on moral judgment depend on decision frame.
targets.evidence_quote: We selected the claim from Experiment 1 that positive moods validate thoughts about pushing in the active decision frame (“yes, it is appropriate to push”) and validate thoughts about not pushing in the passive decision frame (“yes, it is not appropriate to push”), inducing utilitarian responding in the active frame and non utilitarian responding in the passive frame.
